frontHow: The double garage door (500/225) is in the bottom wall of the plan sheet and the entrance door (160/210, into Wiatrolap) faces the bottom edge in the corner beside the garage; the captioned front elevation shows both.

overall.includes: Width is the long main bar (19.50). Depth takes in the main bar (9.60) plus the garage projecting 3.90 to the front. The rear terrace with pergola is not included.

outlineNote: A long single-storey bar 19.50 x 9.60 with a 6.90 wide garage block projecting 3.90 forward from the middle of the front wall.

bodies.name: main
bodies.position: the whole width of the house, the rear 9.60 of the depth

bodies.name: garage
bodies.position: projects forward from the middle of the front wall (from 6.45 to 13.35 of the 19.50 width); its rear part lies under the main roof

uncertain: The two side elevations are captioned only 'elewacja boczna'; assigned from the plan: the one with the large living-room glazing and the garage's glazed side is LEFT, the one with a single bathroom window is RIGHT.

LEFT ground count of 5 = three openings in the main gable wall (260/230, 100/230, 120/140) plus two tall glazed openings 90/210 in the left wall of the projecting garage block, which face left towards the entrance forecourt; whether those two are doors or fixed glazing cannot be told (they are drawn as glazing).
FRONT ground count of 5 = kitchen window 240/140, entrance door 160/210, garage door 500/225 and two windows 100/140 on the right (joined on the elevation by a dark panel that is not an opening).
The entrance door sits in the front wall of the main bar, recessed 3.90 behind the garage front; its alongShare is measured on the full 19.50 front extent.
The gable triangles are drawn in dark cladding with no openings; there is no usable attic shown, so the house is taken as one level.
